headline: Nigeria Government Securities Auction Allotments Drop 55.8% in October
summary: Nigeria's government securities auction allotments fell 55.86% to N9.501 trillion in October 2026 from N21.527 trillion in September due to weaker demand and unallotted investor bids.
why: Government securities auctions reflect domestic liquidity conditions, sovereign borrowing costs, and monetary policy implementation in Africa's largest economy.
